paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon son of Yaakov of Tyre, whom Hyman calls a student of Rabbi Yochanan, [Berakhot 33a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.33a.31).
Rabbi Yishmael, son of Yaakov of Tyre, [Ketubot 7a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.7a.11).[^1]

notes.text: Berakhot gives Shimon as the alternative questioner, and Ketubot gives Yishmael. Both accounts put a question to Rabbi Yochanan in Sidon. [Heilprin’s Yaakov entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2140&lang=en) lists both sons. [His Shimon entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3462&lang=en) compares the two reports and considers a possible copying error.
